## 💡 Feature Description
Clear description of what you want to add.

## 🎯 Use Case
Why do you need this feature? What problem does it solve?

## 🔍 Examples
Examples or mockups of the feature in action.

## 📋 Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've thought of?

## 🎯 Priority
- [ ] Critical (blocks usage)
- [ ] High (important improvement)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (cosmetic/future)

## 📝 Additional Context
Any other information that might be helpful?
